items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: That's when he was married to Doris.

ctx.x: this guy wasn't even a Jazz fan or anything -- he met Charlie Parker and he moved Charlie Parker into his house that night. That's when he was married to Doris. He moved him into his house that night...heh-heh...! So we went by and got him, and hung out with him.

And I'll never forget. We were back near the bathroom, talking, and he was saying how he really regretted pawning the saxophone that he had with the Eckstine band when they were playing at the Club Riviera in St. Louis. He said he got his best sound on that horn. He really regretted losing that instrument.
